text: Cardboard looks flat. Cut it open, and it isn't.
Two thin sheets, with a wave between them.
The wave holds them apart. That gap is strength.
Alone, a thin sheet gives up under one tin.
With the wave inside, the same tin sits still.
Now fold the board into a beam, lock the tabs, and tape the seam.
Three tins, and it hardly bends.
Strong is not thick. Strong is shaped.
